description:
Big, bold, pop-up display.

Capture customers’ interest in a snap with a curved Velcro pop-up display. A low-cost solution that brings in more customers, this curved trade show display will put your brand in the spotlight with a full-color graphic on a sturdy aluminum frame. 

Perfect for trade shows and other big events, a curved Velcro pop-up display is ideal for businesses and organizations that require frequent updating of their marketing signs. 

In addition to trade shows and conferences, you can also set up this pop-up display in schools, theaters, sports centers—any place where you need to meet your customers.

Ready, set up, and go.

Our curved Velcro pop-up display comes with a variety of features that make setting up a breeze: 

  • Full-color and scratch-resistant graphic – The 8.8 tension fabric is made of thick but elastic polyester. Your graphic will be in full display without any wrinkle in sight thanks to the stretchable and scratch-resistant material.
  • Collapsible pop-up frame – Go from one event to the next without fumbling with too many tubes to attach. The aluminum frame has a pop-up mechanism that allows you to collapse and expand the structure with ease.
  • Hook-and loop-Velcro – Fasten your graphic securely with Velcro. This allows you to pull the fabric taut and smoothen out any wrinkles as you go. 
  • Store and carry with a soft canvas bag – Keep dirt away from your graphic with a carrying bag that allows for easy transportation.

Ready to bring in more customers to your business? Order and customize today your own curved trade show display.
